title.en: Oura alternative on the wrist: ring vs screenless band · NEXTBODY
title.zh: Oura 平替在手腕上：戒指和无屏手环怎么选 · NEXTBODY

description.en: Oura is a ring; NEXTBODY Hoop is a screenless wrist band with Body Scan. One same-night sleep comparison on the site is a caveated anecdote, not a clinical study.
description.zh: Oura 是戒指；NEXTBODY Hoop 是带身体扫描的无屏手环。站上那次同晚睡眠对比是有限定的个例，不是临床研究。

h1.en: Ring or wrist: another way to go screenless
h1.zh: 戒指还是手腕：另一种无屏选法

lede.en: A short pointer for “Oura alternative” searches. Form-factor tradeoffs and the HOOP fact table are on the compare hub.
lede.zh: 写给在搜“Oura 平替”的人。形态取舍和 HOOP 事实表在对照页。

p1.en: Oura is a ring. NEXTBODY Hoop is a wrist band with no screen. A ring leaves the wrist free. A band can run HOOP’s Body Scan: hold the side key for about 30 seconds for 14 bioimpedance estimates. That is a different tradeoff, not a claim that a ring is worse.
p1.zh: Oura 是戒指。NEXTBODY Hoop 是无屏手环。戒指不占手腕。手环可以做 HOOP 的身体扫描：按住侧键约 30 秒，得到 14 项生物电阻抗估算。这是不同取舍，不是说戒指更差。

p2.en: The product site includes one same-person, same-night wear with an Oura Ring. Total sleep agreed to 99.5% (awake time excluded). The notes call this a single result, not a clinical finding. HOOP’s seven-factor sleep score draws on Oura’s published sleep factors but is not Oura’s algorithm.
p2.zh: 产品站有一次同一人、同一晚与 Oura Ring 同时佩戴的记录，总睡眠时长一致性 99.5%（不含清醒）。注释写明这是单次结果，不是临床结论。HOOP 七项睡眠分数参考了 Oura 公开的睡眠因素，但不是 Oura 的算法。

p3.en: Do not use Body Scan with a pacemaker or other implanted electronic medical device. HOOP is not a medical device. The published hardware price is $59.99 on the pricing page.
p3.zh: 植入起搏器等电子医疗设备者请勿使用身体扫描。HOOP 不是医疗器械。定价页公布的硬件价是 $59.99。

p4.en: If the search was really “WHOOP alternative no subscription”, or you want the strap-off weight chart next to sleep and MCP limits, use the hub. This note stays short on purpose.
p4.zh: 若你其实在搜“WHOOP 平替、不要订阅”，或想把不含表带的重量图和睡眠、MCP 限制放在一起看，请去对照页。这篇刻意写短。

disclaimer.zh: Oura、Oura Ring 及其他商标归其权利人所有。提及仅为描述。

footer_legal.en: HOOP and the NEXTBODY App are not medical devices and are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease. Data, tips and suggestions are for reference only.
footer_legal.zh: HOOP 与 NEXTBODY App 均非医疗器械，不用于诊断、治疗、治愈或预防任何疾病。数据、提示与建议仅供参考。
